data.name: Saravanan
data.gender_notes: Saravanan is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Saravanan is a name derived from the Sanskrit word 'Sarva' which means 'all' and 'Vanam' which means 'forest'. Saravanan is considered the lord of all forests and the protector of all beings in it. In Hindu mythology, Saravanan is the son of Murugan, also known as Kartikeya, the god of war and son of Shiva. He is often depicted as a warrior riding on a peacock, carrying a spear and a flag.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbol of protection and the lord of all beings in nature
data.etymology: Saravanan belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lord of the Auspicious Way.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Saravanan total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

data.spiritual_significance: Saravanan represents the divine power that protects and nurtures all living beings in nature. He is a symbol of strength, courage, and the power of the natural world, and his name inspires resonance and reverence for the interconnected web of life.

historical_references.reference: Saravanan was a popular name for Tamil Brahmin boys in the 14th and 15th centuries. The name is derived from Saraswati, the goddess of knowledge, and is believed to bring wisdom to the bearer.
Saravanan is also mentioned in the Indian epic Mahabharata as the name of a charioteer of the great warrior Arjuna. He was known for his loyalty and devotion to his master.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name 'Saravanan' is of Hindu origin and translates to 'The One who Protects Gods'. In the modern context, this name is prominently seen in Tamil Nadu politics, particularly in the political career of Mr. Saravanan, a prominent leader in the DMK party. In Hindi cinema, a popular actor by this name, Saravanan Siva Kumar, has made a mark in the industry playing various roles. In the field of Information Technology, there are several professionals and entrepreneurs with this name, contributing significantly to the industry.

name_in_real_life.story: Krishna Saravanan, a teacher in Kathmandu, Nepal, shares that their name Saravanan meaning "Lord of the Auspicious Way" has been a constant source of inspiration, motivating them to follow Hindu values and serve their community.
